steps.text: AC voltage varies sinusoidally: V = V₀ sin(ωt).
RMS value: V_rms = V₀/√2, the DC value with the same heating effect.
Ideal transformer: V_s/V_p = N_s/N_p, and input power equals output power.
A step-up transformer raises voltage and lowers current; step-down does the reverse.
Transformers only work with AC because a changing flux is required.
Rectification converts AC to DC; smoothing reduces the ripple.
